ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast distribution; approximately 35% high-intensity (white) pixels localized at distal lobe tips versus 65% low-intensity (black) pixels across the central and lower fluke regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white blobs located on the upper-outer quadrants of both lobes. Distal left lobe contains a large triangular white patch from mid-edge to tip. Distal right lobe has a similar but slightly more mottled white patch. Heavy transition mottling (black-on-white speckles) along the interior boundaries of these patches.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 42 degrees; depth extends significantly into the central fluke junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations. Distinct jagged peaks (5-15 pixels in height) distributed along the entire trailing edge from notch to tip. Terminal ends show extreme, chaotic topographical variation due to barnacle encrustation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe edges follow a strongly convex trajectory from the central notch towards the distal tips, with the trailing edge curvature increasing significantly in the outer thirds.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel masses (barnacles) concentrated at the extreme distal points of both lobes. Small isolated white circular points scattered within the lower black pigmented region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned vertical white linear disruptions visible on the high-intensity patch of the left lobe; additional faint horizontal rake marks visible on the dark pigmented area of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at lobe tips creating irregular, protruding geometric profiles. Visible linear rake marks and scratches on the upper surfaces of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity specular noise from water droplets and splashing localized at the fluke-water interface at the base of the peduncle.
